NLM names a non-existent render/transcript.rs boundary and its O(k/n), 16ms, and ConHost fallback claims are not local facts.

unverified_hypotheses.hypothesis: When a semantic block is focused during live inspection, its anchored rows can be made visually primary while surrounding anchored rows become quiet without changing text, height, or execution state.
support: CodeGraph shows every live row carries LiveLineAnchor and LiveTranscript exposes focused_block/is_inspecting.
render_live_line_with_alert_edge currently styles channel kind and focused tool details but has no general semantic-focus modifier.
against: Answer/Reasoning focus can already use audit_lines to show only the selected block, so contrast must be limited to mixed live inspection such as focused Tool.
unverified_hypotheses.experiment: Pass the existing focused block into the live line style projection, add bounded focus/non-focus modifier regressions, and verify unchanged rows, width, and PTY behavior.

candidates.core: Add a presentation-only focus modifier to the existing live line renderer: in inspection with an explicit semantic focus, anchored rows matching it gain a restrained primary emphasis and other anchored rows gain quiet contrast; normal Follow/live rendering is unchanged.
constraints: reuse LiveLineAnchor, focused_block, is_inspecting, existing renderer and cache
no new renderer, parser, physical rows, key mapping, execution/provider/MCP/queue state, or fixed performance threshold
preserve Markdown, AlertEdge, Tool folding, Answer/Reasoning rails, CJK width, resize, HOLD/FOLLOW and takeover
risks: do not dim the sole selected Answer/Reasoning audit projection or make reasoning unreadable
only apply when explicit focus exists; ordinary live output and HOLD without focus retain current styling
validation: mixed focused-tool style regression proving focused rows are bold and context rows quiet
Dev/Release PTY with Audit/Inspector, reasoning, answer, folded tool, narrow resize and double Ctrl-C

recommendation: Reject a second audit renderer and all ungrounded numeric/terminal claims. Accept the narrow existing-renderer focus style projection only after local tests prove it changes styling, not content, layout, or interaction semantics.

next_step.value: Implement and verify the anchored semantic-focus style projection in the existing live renderer.

Do not add physical container rows or unbounded per-token storage.
